title: 第23章 这才是鉴天阁少主的待遇第24章 青狐和琉璃的灵体之身也无法破除陈景言的封印
content_zh:
陈景言甚至怀疑庄岩他们认错人了，这个世界长得很像的人多了去了。
而根据叶婉蓉的描述，他好像是个杀手。
难道他们都认错人了吗？
他想起来叶婉蓉说他救她的事情，他试探着问道：“我有没有做过杀手？”
庄岩似乎察觉到了陈景言的异样，连忙解释道：“少阁主，您身份尊贵，在维护大夏的安危的同时，维护世界和平。当年在海外行走，为了行事方便，或许会有一些不为人知的代号或伪装，这也属正常。但您绝不可能是什么杀手，鉴天阁行事，虽不拘小节，却也恪守道义底线，从不滥杀无辜。”
陈景言皱着眉，脑子更乱了。
杀手，圣子，少阁主，天阙军首领，还有那个什么天选之子……现在又加上一个柳家的上门赘婿傻子陈景言。
这么多身份砸下来，他感觉自己快要崩溃了。
庄岩继续说：“少阁主，这里是鉴天阁在江海市的秘密据点，今后你想留在江海市，那这里就是你的行宫，二十四小时有专人伺候。”
可这里的环境和人都很生疏，留下来，多别扭，他说道：“我有家，不需要什么行宫，我先回去了。”
庄岩一听，着急了：“少阁主，你不能回去，明天老阁主和凌霄宗宗主也会过来，你走了，老阁主来了，我们没法交代。”
听庄岩这么一说，倒让陈景言为难了。
庄岩说得这么诚恳，自己执意离去，不顾他们的死活，真有点太不近人情。
这里是郊区，很清静，回到柳家，还要睡地铺，既然二十四小时有专人伺候，那就享受享受。
反正是他们认错人，他又没承认自己是什么鉴天阁少阁主。
“好，那我就先留下来，等你们的阁主来了，我向他们说清楚，我不是什么少阁主。”
庄岩一听陈景言愿意留下来，他很高兴，立即让人给陈景言准备房间。
房间布置得古色古香，檀香袅袅，床榻铺着云锦缎被，窗外竹影婆娑，静得能听见露珠滑落的声音。
陈景言靠在窗边，望着天边残月，脑海中忽然闪过一段画面——画面大多是他作为华文悦的身份经历商场战火纷飞的往事，谈判桌上的唇枪舌剑、资本市场的尔虞我诈，一场场算计，一场场交锋，现在想起来他都感觉热血沸腾。
而他现在寄宿在陈景言的身体里，他只是这个傻子，柳家的赘婿。

这两个身份，一个在云端叱咤风云，一个在泥沼苟延残喘，巨大的反差让他心头一阵刺痛。
他抬手抚上额头，试图驱散那些纷乱的记忆碎片，指尖却触到一丝微凉的液体——不知何时，冷汗已浸湿了鬓角。
“华文悦……陈景言……杜辰……”他低声念着这几个名字，每一个都像是一把钥匙，却又都无法完整地打开他记忆的闸门。
窗外的残月被流云遮蔽，房间内的光线骤然暗淡下来，只剩下檀香的气息在空气中弥漫，带着一种古老而压抑的意味。
佣人引导他来到他的住处。
这是一个独立的小院子，青砖黛瓦，竹篱环绕，院中有很多鲜花，月光洒在花瓣上，泛着淡淡的银辉。微风拂过，花香与竹影交织成一片宁静。
他的会客室和卧房都很大，很豪华。
他走到客房中央那张雕花木桌旁，桌上摆放着一套精致的茶具，旁边还有几样精致的点心。
content_en:
Chen Jingyan even suspected that Zhuang Yan and the others had recognized the wrong person. There were so many people who looked alike in the world.
And according to Ye Wanrong's description, he seemed to be a killer.
Did they all admit the wrong person?
He remembered what Ye Wanrong said about him saving her, and he asked tentatively: "Have I ever been a killer?"
Zhuang Yan seemed to have noticed Chen Jingyan's strangeness, and quickly explained: "Young Pavilion Master, you have a distinguished status. While safeguarding the safety of Daxia, you also maintain world peace. When you were traveling overseas, for the sake of convenience, you might have some unknown code names or disguises, which is normal. But you are definitely not a killer. Although Jiantian Pavilion acts informally, it also adheres to the moral bottom line and never kills innocent people indiscriminately."
Chen Jingyan frowned, his mind even more confused.
The killer, the holy son, the young master of the pavilion, the leader of the Tianque Army, and the chosen son... Now there is added the idiot Chen Jingyan, the Liu family's son-in-law.
With so many identities smashed down, he felt like he was about to collapse.
Zhuang Yan continued: "Young Pavilion Master, this is the secret stronghold of Jiantian Pavilion in Jianghai City. If you want to stay in Jianghai City from now on, then this will be your palace. There will be dedicated personnel to serve you 24 hours a day."
But the environment and people here are very unfamiliar. It would be awkward to stay here. He said: "I have a family and don't need a palace. I will go back first."
When Zhuang Yan heard this, he became anxious: "Young Pavilion Master, you can't go back. Tomorrow the old Pavilion Master and the Lingxiao Sect Master will also come. If you leave, the old Pavilion Master is here, and we can't explain it."
Hearing what Zhuang Yan said made Chen Jingyan embarrassed.
Zhuang Yan said it so sincerely. It was a bit too unkind to insist on leaving without caring about their life or death.
This is a suburb, very quiet. When I return to Liu's house, I have to sleep on the floor. Since there is someone to take care of me 24 hours a day, I can enjoy it.
Anyway, they recognized the wrong person, and he didn't admit that he was the young master of Jiantian Pavilion.
"Okay, then I will stay for now. When your pavilion master comes, I will make it clear to them that I am not a young pavilion master."
When Zhuang Yan heard that Chen Jingyan was willing to stay, he was very happy and immediately asked someone to prepare a room for Chen Jingyan.
The room was decorated in an antique style, with sandalwood lingering in the air. The bed was covered with a cloud brocade quilt. The bamboo shadows danced outside the window, and it was so quiet that you could hear the sound of dewdrops falling.
Chen Jingyan leaned against the window, looking at the waning moon in the sky, and a picture suddenly flashed through his mind - most of the pictures were of his past experiences in the war-torn shopping malls as Hua Wenyue, the bickering at the negotiation table, the intrigues in the capital market, the calculations and the confrontations. Thinking about it now makes his blood boil.
And now he is living in Chen Jingyan's body. He is just this fool, the Liu family's son-in-law.
Between these two identities, one was powerful in the clouds, and the other was lingering in the mire. The huge contrast made his heart sting.
He raised his hand to touch his forehead, trying to dispel the chaotic memory fragments, but his fingertips touched a hint of cool liquid - before he knew it, cold sweat had soaked his temples.
"Hua Wenyue...Chen Jingyan...Du Chen..." He muttered these names in a low voice. Each one was like a key, but none could completely open the gate of his memory.
The waning moon outside the window was obscured by drifting clouds, and the light in the room suddenly dimmed, leaving only the scent of sandalwood filling the air, carrying an ancient and depressing undertone.
The servant guided him to his residence.
This is a small independent courtyard with blue bricks and black tiles, surrounded by bamboo fences. There are many flowers in the courtyard, and the moonlight shines on the petals, giving them a faint silver glow. The breeze blows, and the fragrance of flowers and bamboo shadows interweave into a tranquil atmosphere.
His reception room and bedroom are large and luxurious.
He walked to the carved wooden table in the center of the guest room. There was a set of exquisite tea sets on the table, and several exquisite snacks beside it.
